content.introduction: Welcome to WeCreateX. WeCreateX is a research platform designed to facilitate the exchange of creative work among participants for the purpose of academic research conducted by Nikolas Kunesch as part of his MA research at King's College London. By using WeCreateX, you agree to comply with the Consent Form which outlines the research conditions and you are bound by the following terms and conditions which moderate behavior on the platfrom. Please read these terms carefully.
content.content-1: By accessing and using WeCreateX, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use the platform.
content.content-2: WeCreateX is created solely for the purpose of academic research. It is designed to facilitate non-monetary exchanges of creative work among participants and measure the effects on intrinsic motivation.
content.content-3: Participants must be at least 18 years old, active in the creative industries, and not in professional employment. Participants must reside in London or Germany.
content.content-4: Registration: To use WeCreateX, you must register and create an account. You agree to provide accurate and complete information during registration. Account Security: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account login information and for all activities that occur under your account.
content.content-5: Participants must adhere to the following code of conduct: Respectful Communication: Treat all participants with respect and courtesy. Harassment, discrimination, or abusive behavior will not be tolerated. Prohibited Content: Do not post or exchange any content that is illegal, harmful, threatening, defamatory, obscene, or otherwise objectionable. Intellectual Property: Respect the intellectual property rights of others. Do not post or share work that you do not own or have permission to use. Honesty and Integrity: Engage in honest and constructive exchanges. Do not engage in fraudulent activities or misrepresent your work.
content.content-6: Credits System: The platform uses a credits system for the exchange of creative work. Credits cannot be exchanged for money. Work-for-Work: Participants may exchange creative work for credits, which can be used to obtain other participants' creative work.
content.content-7: No Liability: WeCreateX, Nikolas Kunesch, and King's College London are not liable for any disputes, losses, or damages arising from interactions or exchanges between participants. The platfrom's function is to connect creatives. It cannot gurantee that the information other participants provide is accurate. Any meeting outside the platform (exchnages of work) is fully conducted at participant’s own risk. No Warranty: The platform is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee the accuracy, reliability, or quality of any content exchanged on the platform. Research Use: Your participation and any content you share on the platform may be used for research purposes. Data will be anonymized and treated confidentially as per the Information Sheet for Participants.
content.content-8: Anonymity: Your participation in the survey and activities on the platform will be anonymous. Data Security: Your data will be stored securely on Apple and Azure servers and processed in accordance with UK data protection laws. Data Use: Your data will be used solely for the purposes of this research. For more information on data processing, please refer to the Information Sheet for Participants.
content.content-9: WeCreateX reserves the right to terminate or suspend your account if you violate these terms and conditions or engage in behavior that is detrimental to the platform or its participants.
content.content-10: WeCreateX may update these terms and conditions from time to time. You will be notified of any significant changes, and your continued use of the platform will constitute acceptance of the new terms.
